source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 9 (PDF 205-217), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Human Digestive System) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
9.1 Anatomy and physiology of the digestive system

blocks.prompt:
1 The process by which the body breaks down food into smaller, absorbable components is:
(Woh amal jis se jism ghiza ko chhote, jazb hone wale ajza mein torta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Digestion (hazma) ghiza ko chhote jazb hone wale ajza mein torta hai aur ise energy aur barhne, marammat aur dekh bhaal ke maadde mein badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Digestion is the process by which the body breaks down food into smaller, absorbable components

blocks.prompt:
2 The gastrointestinal (GI) tract is a continuous tube that extends from:
(Gastrointestinal (GI) tract aik musalsal naali hai jo kahan se kahan tak hai?)
blocks.explanation: GI tract mounh se maqad (anus) tak hai: oral cavity, pharynx, oesophagus, stomach, small aur large intestine.

book_ref.quote: The GI tract is a continuous tube that extends from mouth to anus

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of the following is an accessory digestive organ, not a part of the GI tract?
(In mein se kaun sa accessory (madadgaar) digestive organ hai, GI tract ka hissa nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Accessory digestive organs: salivary glands, liver, gallbladder aur pancreas; baqi GI tract ke hisse hain.

book_ref.quote: The accessory digestive organs include the salivary glands, liver, gallbladder and pancreas

blocks.prompt:
4 Lips are made of:
(Hont kis tissue se bane hain?)

options.text: khoon ki naaliyon wala skeletal muscle tissue jis mein bohat se hissi nerve endings hain

blocks.explanation: Hont khoon ki naaliyon se bharpoor skeletal muscle hain jin mein bohat se hissi nerve endings hain; yeh chabate waqt ghiza rokte aur awaz badalne (phonation) mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Lips are made of highly vascularized, skeletal muscle tissue with many sensory nerve endings

blocks.prompt:
5 Phonation, in which lips play a role, means:
(Phonation, jis mein hont kirdar ada karte hain, ka matlab hai:)
blocks.explanation: Hont chabate waqt ghiza rokte hain aur phonation yani awaz ki tabdeeli mein kirdar ada karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They also play a role in phonation (the modification of sound)

blocks.prompt:
6 The physical breakdown of food by the teeth is called:
(Daanton se ghiza ka jismani taur par tootna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mastication (chabana) ghiza ko chhote tukron mein torta hai aur enzymes ke liye satah barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: The ingested food is physically broken down by the teeth through a process called mastication

blocks.prompt:
7 Mixing of chewed food with saliva is helped by:
(Chabayi hui ghiza ko saliva se milane mein kaun madad karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Taalu (palate), zabaan aur gaal chabayi ghiza ko salivary glands ke saliva se milate hain.

book_ref.quote: Palate, tongue and cheeks help in the mixing of chewed food with saliva

blocks.prompt:
8 Which salivary glands are located in front of the ears?
(Kaun se salivary glands kaanon ke saamne hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Teen jore: sublingual (zabaan ke neeche), submaxillary (jabron ke peeche), parotid (kaanon ke saamne).

book_ref.quote: parotid glands located in front of ears

blocks.prompt:
9 How many pairs of salivary glands pour saliva into the oral cavity?
(Kitne jore salivary glands oral cavity mein saliva dalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Salivary glands ke teen jore hain: sublingual, submaxillary aur parotid.

book_ref.quote: sublingual glands situated below tongue

blocks.prompt:
10 Which ions in saliva kill microorganisms?
(Saliva ke kaun se ions jaraseem (microorganisms) ko maarte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Saliva ke bicarbonate ions chemicals ko buffer karte hain; thiocyanate ions jaraseem maarte hain.

book_ref.quote: thiocyanate ions, which kill microorganisms

blocks.prompt:
11 Fresh saliva has pH 8, but quickly gets pH 6 because it:
(Taaza saliva ka pH 8 hota hai magar jaldi pH 6 kyun ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taaza saliva alkaline (pH 8) hota hai magar jaldi CO₂ kho kar pH 6 ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Fresh saliva is alkaline (pH: 8) but it quickly loses CO₂ and gets pH 6

blocks.prompt:
12 Salivary amylase partially digests starch and glycogen into:
(Salivary amylase starch aur glycogen ko juzvi taur par kis mein torta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Salivary amylase polysaccharides (starch aur glycogen) ko juzvi taur par disaccharide maltose mein torta hai.

book_ref.quote: It partially digests the polysaccharides (starch and glycogen) to disaccharides (maltose)

blocks.prompt:
13 After mechanical and chemical digestion in the oral cavity, food forms a small moist mass called:
(Oral cavity mein mechanical aur chemical hazme ke baad ghiza aik chhota geela gola banti hai jise kehte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Oral cavity mein ghiza bolus, stomach mein chyme aur intestine mein chyle banti hai.

book_ref.quote: food mass is in the form of a small moist mass called a bolus

blocks.prompt:
14 The common passageway for both the digestive and respiratory tracts is the:
(Digestive aur respiratory dono raston ki mushtarka guzargah kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pharynx mounh ke peeche aik khala hai aur digestive aur respiratory raston ki mushtarka guzargah hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the common passageway for both the digestive and respiratory tracts

blocks.prompt:
15 During swallowing, the passage between the nasal cavity and pharynx is closed by:
(Nigalte waqt naak ki khala aur pharynx ke darmiyan ka rasta kis se band hota hai?)

options.text: zabaan ka upar peeche jana aur soft palate ka uthna

blocks.explanation: Zabaan upar aur peeche jati hai aur soft palate pharynx ki pichli deewar se lag jata hai; is se naak ka rasta band hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The soft palate is also raised against the back wall of pharynx

blocks.prompt:
16 Swallowing is:
(Nigalna kaisa amal hai?)

options.text: shuru mein ikhtiyari, ghiza mounh ke peeche pohanchne par khud-kaar

blocks.explanation: Nigalne ki shuruat ikhtiyari hai; ghiza mounh ke pichle hisse tak pohanch jaye to nigalna khud-ba-khud ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The beginning of the swallowing action is voluntary

blocks.prompt:
17 In an adult human the oesophagus is about:
(Baligh insaan mein oesophagus taqreeban kitni lambi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oesophagus pharynx ko stomach se jorti hai aur baligh mein taqreeban 25 cm lambi hai.

book_ref.quote: In adult human, the oesophagus is about 25 cm long

blocks.prompt:
18 The exit of food from the oesophagus to the stomach is controlled by the:
(Oesophagus se stomach mein ghiza ka jana kaun control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cardiac (lower oesophageal) sphincter ghiza ke dabao par khulta hai aur stomach ki cheezon ko wapas aane se rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: lower oesophageal sphincter or cardiac sphincter

blocks.prompt:
19 The rhythmic sequence of waves of contraction in the smooth muscles of the alimentary canal is:
(Alimentary canal ki smooth muscles mein sukarne ki lehron ka bahaar-waar silsila kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peristalsis smooth muscles ke sukarne ki lehrein hain jo ghiza ko naali mein aage dhakelti hain.

book_ref.quote: It is the rhythmic sequence of waves of contraction in the smooth-muscles

blocks.prompt:
20 A back-and-forth movement in the same place produced by rings of smooth muscle in the intestines is:
(Intestines mein smooth muscle ke challon se aik hi jagah aage peeche ki harkat kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Smooth muscle ke challe baar baar sukarte aur dheele hote hain, is se small aur large intestine mein segmentation hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: These contractions and relaxations create a back-and-forth movement in the same place

blocks.prompt:
21 Vomiting results from:
(Ulti (vomiting) kis wajah se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Antiperistalsis mein peristalsis ulti chalti hai aur ghiza ko intestines se wapas stomach aur mounh mein le aati hai, jis se ulti hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: pushing food from the intestines back into the stomach and oral cavity, leading to vomiting

blocks.prompt:
22 Hunger contractions are peristaltic movements triggered by:
(Bhook ke sukarao (hunger contractions) kis se shuru hote hain?)

options.text: khoon mein glucose ki zyada miqdaar
khoon mein glucose ki kam miqdaar

blocks.explanation: Hunger contractions khoon mein kam glucose se shuru hone wali peristaltic harkat hain jo bhook ki takleef (hunger pangs) deti hain.

book_ref.quote: hunger contractions are peristaltic movements triggered by low blood glucose levels

blocks.prompt:
23 The stomach is located:
(Stomach kahan waqe hai?)

options.text: pet ki khala ke baayen taraf, diaphragm ke bilkul neeche

blocks.explanation: J shakal ka lachakdaar muscular stomach pet ki khala ke baayen taraf diaphragm ke bilkul neeche, oesophagus aur duodenum ke darmiyan hai.

book_ref.quote: It is located in the left side in abdominal cavity, right below the diaphragm

blocks.prompt:
24 The innermost of the three muscle layers in the stomach wall is made of:
(Stomach ki deewar ki teen muscle tehon mein sab se andar wali teh kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stomach ki muscles: bahar longitudinal, darmiyan circular aur andar oblique.

book_ref.quote: In stomach, there are three layers of muscles

blocks.prompt:
25 The vigorous contractions of the stomach wall help in churning and also:
(Stomach ki deewar ke tez sukarao churning ke ilawa kya karte hain?)

options.text: itni heat banate hain ke thos charbi pighal jaye

blocks.explanation: Stomach ke sukarao ghiza ko mathte, secretions se milate aur itni heat banate hain ke thos charbi pighal jaye.

book_ref.quote: These contractions also generate enough heat that melts the solid fats

blocks.prompt:
26 Back flush of acidic chyme from the stomach into the oesophagus causes:
(Stomach se tezabi chyme ka oesophagus mein wapas aana kya paida karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tezabi chyme ka oesophagus mein wapas aana seene mein dard bhari jalan deta hai: pyrosis ya heartburn.

book_ref.quote: It causes a painful burning sensation in the chest

blocks.prompt:
27 Gastric glands open in the mucosa through deep depressions called:
(Gastric glands mucosa mein kin gehre garhon se khulte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mucosa mein naali numa gastric glands hain jo gehre garhon, gastric pits, se khulte hain.

book_ref.quote: These glands open in the mucosa wall through deep depressions, called gastric pits

blocks.prompt:
28 Hydrochloric acid in the stomach is secreted by:
(Stomach mein hydrochloric acid kaun se cells kharij karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Parietal (oxyntic) cells HCl, chief cells pepsinogen aur mucous cells mucus kharij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The parietal (oxyntic) cells which secrete Hydrochloric acid

blocks.prompt:
29 Pepsinogen is secreted by the:
(Pepsinogen kaun se cells kharij karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gastric glands ke chief cells enzyme pepsinogen kharij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The chief cells which secrete enzyme, pepsinogen

blocks.prompt:
30 HCl adjusts the pH of the stomach contents to about:
(HCl stomach ki cheezon ka pH taqreeban kitna kar deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: HCl stomach ka pH taqreeban 2-3 karta hai, ghiza naram karta hai, pepsinogen ko active karta hai aur jaraseem maarta hai.

book_ref.quote: It adjusts the pH of stomach contents to about 2-3

blocks.prompt:
31 Rennin, found in large amounts in the gastric juice of infants:
(Rennin, jo bachon ke gastric juice mein zyada hota hai, kya karta hai?)

options.text: doodh ki charbi hazam karta hai
lactose ko glucose mein badalta hai
doodh ke proteins jama kar ke doodh ko small intestine mein der se jane deta hai

blocks.explanation: Rennin doodh ke proteins ko jama deta hai aur doodh ko small intestine mein jane se rokta hai taake doosre enzymes proteins hazam kar saken.

book_ref.quote: This enzyme coagulates milk proteins and delays the passage of milk into the small intestine

blocks.prompt:
32 Pepsin breaks down proteins into:
(Pepsin proteins ko kis mein torta hai?)
blocks.explanation: HCl ka H⁺ pepsinogen ko pepsin banata hai jo proteins ko polypeptides aur peptides mein torta hai.

book_ref.quote: Pepsin catalyses the breakdown of proteins to yield polypeptides and peptides

blocks.prompt:
33 The stomach contents become a semi-liquid acidic mass called chyme about how long after a meal?
(Khane ke kitni der baad stomach ki cheezein neem-maae tezabi gola, chyme, ban jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khane ke taqreeban teen se chaar ghante baad stomach ki cheezein neem-maae tezabi chyme ban jati hain; pyloric sphincter ise aage chhorta hai.

book_ref.quote: About three to four hours after a meal

blocks.prompt:
34 In reaction to the smell, sight or thought of food, the message to gastric glands to secrete small amounts of gastric juice is sent by the:
(Ghiza ki khushbu, nazar ya khayal par gastric glands ko thora gastric juice nikalne ka paigham kaun bhejta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ghiza ki khushbu, nazar ya khayal par dimagh ka medulla gastric glands ko paigham bhejta hai (nervous control).

book_ref.quote: the medulla of brain sends message to the gastric glands

blocks.prompt:
35 Proteins in food stimulate endocrine cells of the stomach mucosa to release:
(Ghiza ke proteins stomach ki mucosa ke endocrine cells ko kya kharij karne par ubhaarte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ghiza mein protein par stomach ke endocrine cells gastrin kharij karte hain jo khoon ke zariye gastric glands tak ja kar gastric juice barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: release a hormone called gastrin

blocks.prompt:
36 When food moves from the stomach to the small intestine, the release of HCl is stopped by:
(Jab ghiza stomach se small intestine mein jati hai to HCl ka nikalna kaun rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ghiza stomach se small intestine mein jaye to somatostatin HCl ka nikalna rok deta hai.

book_ref.quote: a hormone called somatostatin stops the release of hydrochloric acid

blocks.prompt:
37 The stomach mucosa is protected from acid and pepsin by:
(Stomach ki mucosa acid aur pepsin se kaise bachti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stomach ki mucosa ki hifazat: gaarha mucus aur bicarbonate jo acid ko neutral karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Protection of the mucosa is provided in two ways

blocks.prompt:
38 The longest part of the alimentary canal is the:
(Alimentary canal ka sab se lamba hissa kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Small intestine sab se lamba hissa hai: baligh mard mein qutr 2-3 cm aur lambai 6 m.

book_ref.quote: It is the longest part of alimentary canal

blocks.prompt:
39 In adult man the small intestine is about:
(Baligh mard mein small intestine taqreeban kitni lambi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Small intestine: qutr taqreeban 2-3 cm aur lambai 6 m.

book_ref.quote: In adult man it is about 2-3 cm in diameter and 6 m in length

blocks.prompt:
40 The duodenum is the first portion of the small intestine, about:
(Duodenum small intestine ka pehla hissa hai, taqreeban kitna lamba?)
blocks.explanation: Small intestine ke pehle 20-25 cm duodenum hain.

book_ref.quote: The first 20 – 25 cm long portion is the duodenum

blocks.prompt:
41 Pancreatic juice is slightly alkaline (pH 8) because of bicarbonate. This helps to:
(Pancreatic juice bicarbonate ki wajah se halka alkaline (pH 8) hai. Is se kya faida hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pancreatic juice bicarbonate ki wajah se halka alkaline (pH 8) hai aur chyme ki acidity neutral karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is slightly alkaline (pH: 8) due to the presence of bicarbonate

blocks.prompt:
42 Trypsinogen is activated into trypsin by:
(Trypsinogen ko trypsin mein kaun badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Duodenum ki deewaron se nikalne wala enterokinase ghair-active trypsinogen ko trypsin banata hai jo proteins ko polypeptides mein torta hai.

book_ref.quote: Another enzyme enterokinase (secreted by the walls of duodenum) activates trypsinogen into trypsin

blocks.prompt:
43 Chymotrypsin and carboxypeptidase of pancreatic juice digest:
(Pancreatic juice ke chymotrypsin aur carboxypeptidase kya hazam karte hain?)

options.text: proteins ko chhote peptides aur phir amino acids mein

blocks.explanation: Chymotrypsin aur carboxypeptidase proteins ko chhote peptides aur phir amino acids mein torte hain.

book_ref.quote: Chymotrypsin and carboxypeptidase, which digest proteins into smaller peptides and then into amino acids

blocks.prompt:
44 Pancreatic nucleases digest DNA and RNA into:
(Pancreatic nucleases DNA aur RNA ko kis mein torte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pancreatic nucleases DNA aur RNA ko nucleotides mein torte hain.

book_ref.quote: Pancreatic nucleases, which digest DNA and RNA into nucleotides

blocks.prompt:
45 Bile salts help fat digestion by acting as:
(Bile salts charbi ke hazme mein kis taur par madad karte hain?)

options.text: detergent molecules jo charbi ko qatron mein torte hain

blocks.explanation: Charbi hal nahi hoti aur lipase is par asaani se asar nahi karta; bile salts detergent ki tarah charbi ko qatron mein tor kar alag rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Bile salts act as detergent molecules

blocks.prompt:
46 Bile, the secretion of the liver, is stored before release in the:
(Liver ki ratoobat bile kharij hone se pehle kahan jama hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bile liver ki ratoobat hai aur kharij hone se pehle gallbladder (pitta) mein jama hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Before its release, it is stored in gallbladder

blocks.prompt:
47 The jejunum, next to the duodenum, is about:
(Duodenum ke baad jejunum taqreeban kitna lamba hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jejunum taqreeban 2.4 m aur ileum, aakhri teen-paanchwan hissa, taqreeban 3.5 m lamba hai.

book_ref.quote: Jejunum is 2.4 meters long part, next to duodenum

blocks.prompt:
48 The ileum forms what part of the small intestine?
(Ileum small intestine ka kitna hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ileum small intestine ka aakhri teen-paanchwan hissa, taqreeban 3.5 m hai.

book_ref.quote: Ileum is the last three fifth i.e., about 3.5 metres long part of small intestine

blocks.prompt:
49 In intestinal juice, aminopeptidase digests:
(Intestinal juice mein aminopeptidase kya hazam karta hai?)

options.text: lactose ko glucose aur galactose mein

blocks.explanation: Aminopeptidase: polypeptides se dipeptides; erepsin: dipeptides se amino acids.

book_ref.quote: aminopeptidase digests polypeptides into dipeptides

blocks.prompt:
50 The intestinal enzyme that digests dipeptides into amino acids is:
(Woh intestinal enzyme jo dipeptides ko amino acids mein torta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Erepsin (kitaab mein ghalti se 'erypsin') dipeptides ko amino acids mein torta hai.

book_ref.quote: The intestinal enzyme that digests dipeptides into amino acids is erepsin

blocks.prompt:
51 Sucrase digests sucrose into:
(Sucrase sucrose ko kis mein torta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sucrase: sucrose se glucose aur fructose; lactase: lactose se glucose aur galactose; maltase: maltose se glucose.

book_ref.quote: sucrase digests sucrose into glucose and fructose

blocks.prompt:
52 Which enzyme of intestinal juice digests lactose?
(Intestinal juice ka kaun sa enzyme lactose hazam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lactase lactose ko glucose aur galactose mein torta hai.

book_ref.quote: lactase digests lactose into glucose and galactose

blocks.prompt:
53 After the action of the enzymes of intestinal juice, chyme is converted into an alkaline emulsion called:
(Intestinal juice ke enzymes ke baad chyme aik alkaline emulsion mein badalta hai jise kehte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Intestinal juice ke enzymes ke baad chyme alkaline emulsion, chyle, ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: the chyme is converted into an alkaline emulsion, called chyle

blocks.prompt:
54 Absorption of digested food, water and dissolved minerals occurs in the:
(Hazam shuda ghiza, paani aur hal shuda minerals ka jazb kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jazb jejunum aur ileum mein hota hai jin ki andaruni deewar mein bari gol tahein aur un par villi hain.

book_ref.quote: The absorption of digested food, water, and dissolved minerals occurs in jejunum and ileum

blocks.prompt:
55 The lymphatic vessel inside each villus is called a:
(Har villus ke andar lymphatic naali kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har villus mein khoon ki baareek naaliyan aur lymph naali, lacteal, hai jo aik cell moti epithelium se dhaki hai.

book_ref.quote: Each villus is richly supplied with blood capillaries and a vessel of lymphatic system, called lacteal

blocks.prompt:
56 The countless cytoplasmic projections of the epithelial cells of villi are called:
(Villi ke epithelial cells ke be-shumar cytoplasmic ubhaar kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Villi ke epithelial cells par microvilli hain; villi aur microvilli jazb ki satah ko behad bara banate hain.

book_ref.quote: The epithelial cells of villi have countless cytoplasmic projections, called microvilli

blocks.prompt:
57 The internal surface of jejunum and ileum appears velvety due to:
(Jejunum aur ileum ki andaruni satah makhmali kyun dikhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tahein aur be-shumar villi jejunum aur ileum ki andaruni satah ko makhmali banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Due to the presence of folds and numerous villi, the internal surface of jejunum and ileum appears velvety

blocks.prompt:
58 Absorbed sugars and amino acids are carried from the villi to the liver by the:
(Jazb shuda sugars aur amino acids villi se liver tak kis ke zariye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Villi ki khoon ki naaliyan mil kar hepatic portal vein banati hain jo sugars aur amino acids liver tak le jati hai; phir hepatic vein dil tak jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Blood capillaries of villi join to form hepatic portal vein

blocks.prompt:
59 From the liver, the required amounts of sugars and amino acids pass to the heart via the:
(Liver se sugars aur amino acids ki zaroori miqdaar dil tak kis ke zariye jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Liver zaa'id glucose (glycogen) aur amino acids (proteins) jama karta hai; zaroori miqdaar hepatic vein se dil tak jati hai.

book_ref.quote: From liver, the required amounts of these products pass to heart via hepatic vein

blocks.prompt:
60 Inside the villi, triglycerides coated with proteins form small droplets called:
(Villi ke andar proteins se lipte triglycerides chhote qatre banate hain jinhein kehte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Villi mein fatty acids aur glycerol dobara triglycerides bante hain; proteins se lipat kar chylomicrons bante hain jo lacteals mein jate hain.

book_ref.quote: In this way small droplets, called chylomicrons, are formed

blocks.prompt:
61 From the lacteals, chylomicrons reach the bloodstream through the:
(Lacteals se chylomicrons khoon tak kis ke zariye pohanchte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chylomicrons lacteals se thoracic lymphatic duct mein aur wahan se khoon mein jate hain.

book_ref.quote: From the lacteals, the chylomicrons move into thoracic lymphatic duct

blocks.prompt:
62 Fatty acids and glycerol are absorbed into the epithelial cells of villi by:
(Fatty acids aur glycerol villi ke epithelial cells mein kaise jazb hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fatty acids aur glycerol passive transport se jazb hote hain; saada sugars aur amino acids diffusion ya active transport se.

book_ref.quote: are absorbed by passive transport into the epithelial cells of villi

blocks.prompt:
63 The large intestine occupies about:
(Large intestine kitna hissa gherti hai?)

options.text: intestinal tract ka aakhri taqreeban aik meter

blocks.explanation: Large intestine small intestine se kaafi chhoti hai aur intestinal tract ka taqreeban aakhri aik meter hai.

book_ref.quote: occupying about the last metre of the intestinal tract

blocks.prompt:
64 Which statement about the large intestine is correct?
(Large intestine ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: yeh naali ka sab se lamba hissa hai
is mein villi wali bari gol tahein hain
yeh bal-daar nahi aur is mein villi nahi

blocks.explanation: Large intestine bal-daar nahi aur is ki andaruni satah par villi nahi; yeh paani, salts aur vitamin K jazb karti hai.

book_ref.quote: The large intestine is not convoluted and its inner surface area does not possess villi

blocks.prompt:
65 The vermiform appendix arises from the blind end of the:
(Vermiform appendix kis ke band sire se nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Caecum ileum aur colon ke darmiyan band thaili hai; is ke band sire se ungli numa vermiform appendix nikalta hai jo insaan mein vestigial (be-kaar) hai.

book_ref.quote: From the blind end of caecum there arises a finger-like process called vermiform appendix

blocks.prompt:
66 The surgical removal of an infected appendix is called:
(Infected appendix ko operation se nikalna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Appendicitis appendix ki sozish hai, aam taur par bacteria se; is ka operation se nikalna appendicectomy hai.

book_ref.quote: The surgical removal of appendix is called appendicectomy

blocks.prompt:
67 The colon has:
(Colon ke kitne hisse hain?)
blocks.explanation: Caecum ke baad colon hai jis ke ascending, transverse aur descending hisse hain; is ka bara kaam paani jazb karna hai.

book_ref.quote: It has an ascending, a transverse and a descending limb

blocks.prompt:
68 The external anal sphincter is made of:
(Bairooni anal sphincter kis muscle se bana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Anus ke do sphincters hain: andar wala smooth muscle aur bahar wala striated muscle.

book_ref.quote: the internal sphincter is made of smooth muscles and the outer is made of striated muscles

blocks.prompt:
69 Bacteria such as E. coli living in the colon produce vitamin K, which is necessary for:
(Colon mein rehne wale E. coli jaise bacteria vitamin K banate hain jo kis ke liye zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Colon ke E. coli jaise bacteria amino acids aur vitamin K banate hain; vitamin K khoon jamne ke liye zaroori hai aur large intestine se jazb hota hai.
